name: Jean de Vivonne, sieur de Saint-Gouard, French ambassador in Madrid, cipher dispatches to Henri III and Catherine de Medicis 1579-82 (the table later left to Longlee)
ciphertext: tx/passA.tsv and tx/passB.tsv (fr.16107 c107 left page, f.101v, 32 lines, 1,307 / 1,273 signs, two blind Sonnet passes, labels tx/SIGNS.md); unreconciled, err_2reader 0.576
ciphertext_source: BnF fr.16107 (Gallica ark btv1b9009661v), canvas 107 left page, IIIF native crops via tools/iiif_lines.py, fetched 4 Oct 2026 (VIV-T); letter of 2 Mar 1580 Saint-Gouard to the King, c107-c109 left (f.101v-103v)
alphabet: letter-form mark system (fr.16107 and fr.16108 c80/c102): about 30-40 distinct marks (x, doubled long-s, H/#, t, =, dots, Greek- and figure-like signs); the digit-and-mark system of fr.16108 c256/c322/c388/c432 is a second system not used in this pair. Inventory unsettled (provisional tx/SIGNS.md).
constraints: clerk's plain copy 'Dechiffre de la precedente' follows the cipher letter in the volume: fr.16107 c110 right (f.105r) for the 2 Mar 1580 letter (VIV-T); Gachard II counts 26 such pairs in fr.16107 and 28 in fr.16108
Tomokiyo: Vivonne used this table from 1579 to end 1582 and left it to Longlee; Mousset 1912 pp.lviii-lix reconstructs Longlee's cipher (published key, not on disk as a table)
~90 dense cipher canvases estimated without a decipherment leaf (VIV-M, interval reaching 0)
cheap_tests_in_order: 1 (run, VIV-T): grade-C key by tools/stream_align (interlinear_align stream) from one in-volume pair, held-out known-answer test vs value-shuffle and wrong-window nulls, with a matched power control at the measured transcription error (PREREG_test1.md)
2: settle the sign inventory in the owner's sign sorter (two machine passes split 58%), then re-run test 1 on the settled labels
3: Mousset pp.lviii-lix table applied to the same page (published key) as a key check
4: fitted key on one unglossed letter, judge fr16 vs a shuffled-key null
matched_control: synthetic homophonic encipherment of the same clear letters with pass A's symbol count, symbol noise at e=0.576 and e=0.10, 20% of clear words dropped for the fitter, same split/fit/statistic/nulls/gate, 5 seeds (test1.py)

cheap_test_done.test: 1 (held-out known-answer test of a stream_align key, PREREG_test1.md)
cheap_test_done.method: fr.16107 c107 left (f.101v, 2 Mar 1580) vs clerk copy c110 right (f.105r); 2 blind Sonnet passes, err_2reader 0.576; fit L01-L20, held-out L21-L32; nulls value-shuffle x1000 and wrong-window x347
cheap_test_done.target: pass A 0.370 vs value-shuffle p99 0.396 / wrong-window p99 0.385 (pass B 0.355 vs 0.407/0.405)
cheap_test_done.control: matched synthetic homophonic, same K and length, 20% clear words dropped: e=0.576 0/5 seeds PASS; e=0.10 3/5 PASS (0.69-0.72 vs nulls ~0.39)
cheap_test_done.verdict: NON-TEST (control below gate at the measured reader error); next: owner sign sorter on c107 crops, full read of the copy, re-run on the whole letter

judge.corpus: tools/data/fr16 (Lettres de Catherine de Medicis t.1-2, Marguerite de Valois letters; 16th-century French court/diplomatic register): era-matched for 1580

value: a period-key pool of ~450 cipher pages (VIV-M estimate) with in-volume clerk copies for calibration; Longlee 1583-88 already printed in clear by Mousset
